retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait with bold, wide-set red serif typography at the top and italicized white sans-serif at the bottom.
excludeWhen: minimalist modern sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-contrast black and white portrait of a male subject looking downward, framed by a stark white background. The layout features a dominant red header in an ultra-wide serif font and a secondary white italicized title in the lower right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Red header text contrasts against the monochrome image
Subject's downward gaze creates a somber, reflective mood
High-contrast lighting emphasizes hair texture and facial contours
Asymmetrical secondary text balances the centered subject
coreInvariants: Ultra-wide serif header in bright red

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold red header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red header, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the gaze toward the bottom right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and sides of the head to isolate the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject's dark suit/hair and the white background; high saturation for the red text.

letterConstructionRules: Secondary text uses a condensed, slanted humanist skeleton
characterSpecificRedesigns: V and A in header have wide apertures
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of an expanded, traditional serif with a condensed, modern italicized sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Small technical metadata box in bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, sharp serif feel of the header
Matches the humanist sans-serif structure of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white medium close-up portrait of a man in a suit looking down, set against a plain white studio background with ample head room.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a bold, ultra-expanded red serif font at the top center. Add the title in a bold, white italicized sans-serif font in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the header text ultra-wide and red?
Is the subtitle italicized and placed in the bottom right?

mustAchieve: Sharp photographic detail in hair and skin

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is the most saturated element
Ensure the subject's eyes are cast downward
Verify the bottom-right text has a subtle drop shadow for legibility
Confirm the background is nearly pure white
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Ultra-Wide Red Serif Header + Bottom-Right Italicized White Subtitle
